name: Shilhi
overview: Shilhi is a male figure known primarily as the father of Azubah, mentioned in 1 Kings 22:42. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal details in Scripture. His mention is brief, serving to identify his daughter’s lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Shilhi is a proper name and is possibly derived from a Hebrew root meaning 'my javelin thrower.' This suggests a personal or familial connection to a warrior or military role, though the Bible does not elaborate further on this meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Shilhi is recorded in Scripture as the father of Azubah, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Beyond this, no other family relationships or descendants are noted in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Shilhi’s significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his role as the father of Azubah, who is mentioned in the genealogical context of 1 Kings 22:42. His mention helps to situate Azubah within the lineage and background of the individuals referenced in the account, contributing to the historical and familial framework of the biblical record.
